During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] maintained a '''base''' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Qetix IV]] in the [[Dresscol system/Legends|Dresscol system]] in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]]. It was dedicated to [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] maintenance and repair.
